# PROBE P04 NRPN: NRPN variants incl. LSB over 127
VERSION 1
TRACKNAME P04 NRPN
TYPE NULL
OUTPORT NULL
OUTCHAN NULL
INPORT NULL
INCHAN NULL

[DRUMLANES]
[/DRUMLANES]

[PC]
[/PC]

[CC]
[/CC]

[NRPN]
0:1:7 R01 plain
0:2:7:DEFAULT=64 R02 default64
0:3:7:64 R03 bare 4th field
0:1026:7 R04 msb0 lsb1026 eq 8-2
:2000:7 R05 no msb lsb2000 eq 15-80
0:4:14:DEFAULT=10000 R06 14bit default
[/NRPN]

[ASSIGN]
[/ASSIGN]

[AUTOMATION]
[/AUTOMATION]

[COMMENT]
[/COMMENT]
